Workforce Reduction: The Company is reducing its workforce by approximately 45%, with the reduction expected to be completed during the fourth quarter of 2026.

The Company estimates that it will incur charges of approximately $2 million for severance and other employee termination-related costs, with the majority of such costs to be incurred in the fourth quarter of 2026.

Reduced Quarterly Operating Cash Spending: As cost reductions take effect and REMAIN-1 Pivotal Cohort expenditures decline, the Company expects quarterly operating cash spending to be reduced by approximately 50%, to approximately $8 million, by the end of Q2 2027.

There can be no assurance that the Company’s review of strategic alternatives for Rejuva will result in any transaction, and the Company does not intend to disclose further developments unless and until it determines that disclosure is appropriate or required.

As in all applications, the FDA indicated that final pathway determinations will be made following review of the complete safety dataset, which the Company intends to include in its potential De Novo submission.

Based on current business plans, the Company believes its cash position will fund operations into the second quarter of 2027, through the planned De Novo submission and anticipated 12-month REMAIN-1 Pivotal Cohort data, subject to compliance with the minimum liquidity covenant under the Company’s credit agreement, as discussed further in the “Liquidity and Capital Resources” section of our Quarterly Report on…

dropped.t: The Company also reiterated all previously disclosed 2026 Revita ® clinical and regulatory milestones, including topline 6-month randomized data from the REMAIN-1 Pivotal Cohort expected in early Q4 2026, and its cash runway guidance into early 2027.

“Together with a favorable one-year safety profile and cash runway into early 2027, these results give us continued confidence in the design and execution of our ongoing REMAIN-1 Pivotal Cohort, with topline six-month data on track for early Q4 2026 and a potential FDA De Novo submission to follow later in the quarter.
As we approach these anticipated milestones, we are also building the commercial infrastructure needed to bring Revita to the patients with the greatest need.”

Zumdahl brings experience building reimbursement and health economic infrastructure for breakthrough procedural therapies, most recently at Inari Medical, and joins Fractyl as the Company prepares for the anticipated REMAIN-1 Pivotal Cohort topline readout in early Q4 2026.
The Company reiterates its previously announced cash runway into early 2027, beyond the anticipated pivotal data readout.
